name: steps_L3_tail_supported_walker
description: Every foot arm bears directly on the main axle. Sprocket faceplates index the arms using diameter pin pairs; two reverse 32009 cranks and one straight 11L arm with a keyed L shoe make approximately equal-reach feet. 25:1 XL drive with 24T input phase chain, pinned rear cages and outboard bearings. The short foot shaft uses an inner bearing/shoe sandwich so every tyre stays within y=+/-129 mm, giving more course-edge margin. A low-mass pinned trailing roller arrests back-tip, while the existing battery sits over the front axle as a counterweight. The tail rails now mount through two pinned frames rather than stud pads. A studless cap and two-axis pin ties carry the tail load into the drivetrain; the leg splices overlap by 32 mm. The third arms use 13L beams for 80 mm centre radius, increasing the weakest adjacent-foot step-height margin. Half-bush collars capture each complete arm/faceplate stack on both sides of its shaft. Friction axle-pins replace the four frictionless indexing pins, with full 8 mm axle engagement and unchanged 4 mm faceplate engagement. Two parallel 8:40 rear output meshes share the climbing load. The positive pair sits at y=56 on the original one-piece 16L shaft; half-bush stops retain both added gears.
